mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runner_refresh_token (runner_id, refresh_token, updated_at) values (#{runnerId}, #{refreshToken}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT(runner_id) DO UPDATE SET refresh_token = #{refreshToken}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT runner_id, refresh_token, created_at, updated_at FROM runner_refresh_token WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId}
